Software Requirements Specification
OC Quantity Reduction After RMPO Creation (Inquiry Order Qty reduction upto zero on split only)
Document # 379687
Version 1.0 ● 10/11/2025
Contents
Section 1: Overview 3

Section 3. Revision History 4

# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose
This functionality should only be permitted when splitting an inquiry order, enabling the inquiry order quantity to be reduced up to zero on splitting. In other case should not allow user to reduce the Qty of Inquiry Order to zero.

# Business Requirement
Currently, user can reduce the Qty of Inquiry order to zero. We need the functionality that restrict the reduction of inquiry order if RMPO is created against that OC, and if the Inquiry Order is splitting in that case it can be reduced to zero.

# Section 2. Solution

### FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
We need the functionality that restrict the reduction of inquiry order if RMPO is created against that OC, and if the Inquiry Order is splitting in that case it can be reduced to zero. Need a permission “restrict to reduce to zero in Inquiry Order” on OC revision.
Case1: Inquiry order created = 1000 Qty
RMPO created for 1000
now if the permission is given to user then the user can’t reduce the inquiry order=0
on revision.
Case2: Inquiry order created = 1000 Qty
RMPO created for 1000
now if inquiry order is split to summary PO=1000 Qty
in that case it allows to revise the order.
